sources.quote: the audit qualifies the company. Part approvals stay as they are.
SUP-C,Meccanica Chisone S.r.l.,aluminium extrusions and blanks

findings.why: The re-audit restored company-level standing only. No controlled approval record covers PN-050 for Chisone, a receiving plant or a customer. The customer for PRG-X is not stated in any document. Chisone is listed as an aluminium supplier and the pin is steel, so absence of approval cannot be read as 'not approved'. A person must confirm.

sources.quote: Chisone is qualified for 6061-T6 and 6082-T5 only.

findings.why: The drawing requires 42CrMo4 steel. Chisone's documented qualification covers only aluminium alloys. No 3.1 material certificate for 42CrMo4 from Chisone is in the documents, so a person must say whether one exists.
